title: Tech Note: Custom File Drag and Drop Area
author: Bryan Yen, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: Form events (On Drag Over, On Mouse Leave, On Drop)

historical_commentary.text: The event-driven drag-and-drop technique and collection-based listbox pattern described here are still valid and commonly used in classic 4D form development today. The approach hasn't been architecturally superseded, though modern 4D Explorer-style projects might also consider a web-based (HTML5 drag/drop in a web area) alternative for cross-platform consistency.
related_updates: Still a standard approach for native 4D form UIs; collections/object notation used throughout remain current 4D practice
